copy.headline: City Improves Pedestrian Safety, Access in Entertainment District
copy.caption: Key project improvements include new concrete sidewalks and paving tie‑ins throughout the Entertainment District to close sidewalk gaps and improve ADA‑compliant pedestrian access to various locations in the district.
